DUEL_BLITZ.title: 1v1 Duel: Real-Time
DUEL_BLITZ.description: Two players race the same map, then duel. Both act at once - actions resolve in the order they are made, so speed decides trades.
DUEL_TURN_BASED.title: 1v1 Duel: Turn-Based
DUEL_TURN_BASED.description: Two players race the same map, then duel. Both plan in secret and lock in, then the turn resolves at once.
RACE_CLOCK_EIGHT.title: Race Clock: 8 min
RACE_CLOCK_EIGHT.description: Each player has 8 minutes to reach the arena. Run out and you lose.
RACE_CLOCK_TEN.title: Race Clock: 10 min
RACE_CLOCK_TEN.description: Each player has 10 minutes to reach the arena. Run out and you lose.
RACE_CLOCK_FIFTEEN.title: Race Clock: 15 min
RACE_CLOCK_FIFTEEN.description: Each player has 15 minutes to reach the arena. Run out and you lose.
RACE_CLOCK_TWELVE.title: Race Clock: 12 min
RACE_CLOCK_TWELVE.description: Each player has 12 minutes to reach the arena. Run out and you lose.
RACE_CLOCK_NONE.title: Race Clock: Off
RACE_CLOCK_NONE.description: No deadline for reaching the arena. Take as long as you like.
DUEL_CLOCK_ONE.title: Duel Clock: 1 min
DUEL_CLOCK_ONE.description: A fresh 1 minute bank each when the duel begins. Short enough to run out on purpose - handy for testing the timer.
DUEL_CLOCK_TWO.title: Duel Clock: 2 min
DUEL_CLOCK_TWO.description: A fresh 2 minute bank each when the duel begins. Run out and you lose.
DUEL_CLOCK_THREE.title: Duel Clock: 3 min
DUEL_CLOCK_THREE.description: A fresh 3 minute bank each when the duel begins. Run out and you lose.
DUEL_CLOCK_FIVE.title: Duel Clock: 5 min
DUEL_CLOCK_FIVE.description: A fresh 5 minute bank each when the duel begins. Run out and you lose.
DUEL_CLOCK_NONE.title: Duel Clock: Off
DUEL_CLOCK_NONE.description: No time limit in the duel. Nobody can lose on time there.
DUEL_SPEED_FAST.title: Enabled
DUEL_SPEED_FAST.description: Cards resolve with shorter animations. Both duelists use the agreed speed, so the clocks measure the same thing.
